entities.summary: Asaki Takamori , known by the pen names Ikki Kajiwara  and Asao Takamori , was a Japanese author, manga writer, and film producer. He is known for the work about sports and martial arts, with images of heroic young men with the occasional fine details as he moves from one topic to another. He considered Tiger Mask and Star of the Giants to be his life's work.
